root_cause.text: The function `stm32_dmamux_route_allocate` fails to release the device reference obtained when looking up the DMA mux platform device, causing a device reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `put_device(&pdev->dev)` on both error paths and the success path, and the commit message explicitly states: "Make sure to drop the reference taken when looking up the DMA mux platform device during route allocation."
